cohort: 176 patients with congenital uterine anomalies who underwent hysteroscopy from January 1, 2013 till January 1, 2016
finding: Hysteroscopy was significant in diagnosing and treating congenital uterine anomalies, with 1/5 of women achieving pregnancy within 12 months after the procedure, and a reduction in miscarriage rate from 38% to 15%.
